bullets: Cruise with commentary from a naturalist or marine biologist.
sections.title: What’s included

bullets: Children aged 3 and under ride free and must be included in the passenger count.
Tips are optional and are not included in the price.
sections.text: The cruise lasts about 1.5 hours. The fulfilment clause sets out the schedule and booking requirements.
sections.title: Good to know

sections.text: Snug Harbor Marina, 645 Old San Carlos Blvd, Fort Myers Beach, FL 33931. The marina and ticket office are under Sky Bridge, next to Nervous Nellie’s.
sections.title: Meeting point

sections.text: The offer lists cutoffs of 24 hours for regular cruises, 14 days for holiday cruises, and 48 hours for groups of six or more. A 6% booking fee is deducted from refunds. Changes and cancellations within 24 hours of departure incur a 100% charge. Cancellations by email or voicemail are not accepted.
sections.title: Cancellation terms listed in the offer

offer.text: This afternoon cruise around Fort Myers Beach and Sanibel Island lasts about 1.5 hours. A naturalist or marine biologist talks about dolphins and local wildlife. Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed.
offer.title: Afternoon Dolphin & Wildlife Cruise

fulfilmentTerms.fulfilmentText: The order requires a proposed time and confirmation from Adventures in Paradise. The customer accepts the proposed time when accepting the order. If the supplier proposes a different time, the customer must accept it.

agreementDescription: Reseller agreement for the Afternoon Dolphin & Wildlife Cruise. Adventures in Paradise operates the cruises, and Manatee Bay Inn recommends them to guests and earns a commission on confirmed net order receipts.
